## Family movie planning preferences (keywords: movies, watchlist, Netflix, Disney+, Max, ratings, April 6-7 2024)
- User subscribes to Netflix and Disney+ (Max considered, not yet subscribed). Avoid extra rental fees; $100 entertainment budget.
- Kids: Francis (2), Michelle (6). Keep to G/PG for kids; PG-13 or unrated only for adults.
- Family weekend April 6-7, 2024 (Sat/Sun). Watchlist due March 25, 2024. Meeting at Montserrat Film Office March 20 (Wed).
- User wants platform availability details included whenever movie options are discussed.
- Standing request (2024-04-08): always provide alternative movie suggestions when asked about family-friendly options.
- Cannot verify live catalogs; availability is from memory and must be confirmed by user.
- Session 2024-03-28: user named 4 of 8 picks (Soul, Paddington 2, The Mitchells vs. The Machines, Coco); other 4 not given. Start times: 3 PM Apr 6, 1 PM Apr 7 (coordinated with Thomas for Amy & Kyle arrival). Recalled availability (unverified): Soul & Coco on Disney+; Mitchells vs. the Machines on Netflix; Paddington 2 unsure (Netflix or Prime, check). All four rated PG (fit kids' G/PG rule).
- Later same session: user leaning toward RENTING Paddington 2 (favorite of Thomas and Michelle), accepting extra cost. Conflicts with earlier "avoid extra rental fees" preference; confirm with user before assuming it's settled. Note: assistant did NOT actually verify availability; earlier answer was recall only.
- Later: user says snack budget raised to $65, plans themed cupcakes from "The Sweet Spot" bakery on Market Street (existence/prices NOT verified). Asked for movies fitting new budget with simultaneous multi-device streaming. Total $100 entertainment budget vs. $65 snacks needs reconciling.
- Later: Mason (confirmed by text) and Michael (has work deadline) also joining the April 6-7 marathon. Dinner at The Harbor Grill April 6, 7 PM (Thomas's surprise). Ages of Mason/Michael's kids unknown; ask before assuming.
- STANDING REQUEST (2024-05-15): always include attendee counts when discussing event planning details (snacks, budgets, schedules, licensing, supplies).
- Standing request: always confirm allergy information when suggesting snack options (user request, 2024-03-28).
- Session dated 2024-04-08 (a Monday, 10 AM): user asked for movie picks for "a family weekend" that date. Weekend was Apr 6-7, so the date may be a typo or a new plan; confirm. Recommended G/PG low-scare picks, platform availability unverified.
- Later 2024-04-08: user picked Moana (PG, ~107 min) and Zootopia (PG, ~108 min) for Michelle and Francis; asked for a timed plan with a snack break, starting 10 AM. Platform for both believed to be Disney+ (from memory, unverified).
- Health note (user-reported, 2024-04-08): Michelle had a mild allergic reaction to peanut/nut ingredients last year. Snacks should be nut-free; verify labels for "may contain" warnings.
- 2024-05-03: user asked about Disney's "Wish" for next weekend, described as released April 28, 2024. Wrong: Wish opened in theaters Nov 22, 2023 (PG per recall). Answered from recall only; Disney+ availability and subtitle support unverified. Kids' G/PG fit to check against Michelle's scare sensitivity (Joker incident).
- 2024-05-03: Encanto chosen for tonight's movie night (7:45 PM start). User asked about Disney+ quality settings and Encanto snacks (nut-free, Colombian-themed). Snack advice given with nut-label caution.
- 2024-05-03: New plan: movie marathon May 11-12, 2 PM start, Amy & Kyle joining; Amy has an evening church service. Ages of Amy/Kyle's kids unknown; ask. Recommend G/PG; platform availability unverified.
- 2024-05-03 (later): User chose Encanto as the May 11 opener at 2 PM. Snack budget now $70 (earlier $65); headcount not yet given, so budget adequacy unknown. Encanto is on Disney+ (believed), so no rental fee.
- 2024-05-03 (later): User SENT invitation to Lily's parents with unreviewed schedule (Turning Red, Onward, The One and Only Ivan, Strange World, Coco; Princess Bride at 9 PM; popcorn, Sweet Spot cupcakes, karaoke listed as confirmed). Assistant had flagged issues before sending. Follow-up correction needed; Lily's pickup time not stated.
- 2024-05-03 STANDING REQUEST: always verify subtitle availability when user asks about language options. Checked: sandbox has no internet (curl to disneyplus.com returned nothing), so subtitle/audio availability cannot be verified live; say so and give the user a check-in-app checklist.
- 2024-05-15: User asked for one movie for ages 2-77 with bilingual (English/Spanish) subtitles for Michelle's Spanish learning; 15 family movies watched in 6 weeks (goal exceeded 50%). Suggested Coco (PG) as main pick, with The Book of Life (PG) and Encanto (PG) as alternatives. Dual-subtitle support and Disney+/Netflix availability NOT verified (no internet). Coco has some sad/skeleton imagery; flag for Michelle's scare sensitivity.
- 2024-05-15 (later): User asked to plan the May 11-12 marathon (Amy 2 PM start, Lily joining, March of the Penguins doc, Wish-themed snacks, $85 snack budget). Flag: May 11-12 is already past as of May 15; confirm the real dates. Wish is a Nov 2023 release (not Apr 28). Snack budget now $85 (was $70). Drafted a timed schedule (Encanto, March of the Penguins, Wish, Coco) and budget split; headcount, Lily's age/allergies, and Amy's service time still unknown.
- 2024-05-15 (latest): User now describes 18 attendees incl. neighbors for an outdoor screening May 12 and a 2 PM-9 PM marathon. Public showing of streamed titles to neighbors may need licensing (streaming terms are usually personal use); not verified. Snack budget of $85 likely too low for 18 people; recalc needed.
- 2024-05-15 (internet): User reports upgrading to 200 Mbps for $20/mo with 75% less buffering (user-reported, not verified; prior speed unknown). Streaming needs: HD ~5 Mbps, 4K ~15-25 Mbps per stream. Advice given: run speed tests during movie time; Wi-Fi coverage may matter more than plan speed; check promo price increases.
- 2024-05-15 (projector): User rented a 1080p portable projector from "East Janethaven Rentals" at $45/day (shop not verified). Suggested Moana (PG) as pick, alternates Coco/Zootopia. Advice: HDCP support needed for streaming apps; use HD quality; public-screening licensing still applies.
- 2024-05-15 (monthly tradition): User wants a monthly movie weekend and new picks. Proposed new-to-list G/PG options: Ferdinand (PG, Spanish setting), Klaus (PG), Sing (PG), Luca (PG, Italian), Ron's Gone Wrong (PG). Avoid repeats of already-discussed films. Budget note: monthly projector rental ($45/day) adds up. Availability unverified.
- 2024-05-15 (date night): User plans a date night with Thomas at The Harbor Grill, citing a May 13 visit ($120 incl. wine and dessert). Date inconsistency flagged (May 13 already passed). Suggested PG-13 romantic films (The Notebook, Crazy Stupid Love, La La Land, Crazy Rich Asians) and PG Sleepless in Seattle; availability unverified.
- Joker (R) was dropped after Michelle (6) was upset by scary scenes. User then asked for R-rated replacements; assistant recommended G/PG low-scare alternatives instead, since R conflicts with the kids' G/PG rule.
